nodes.name: Start the night for one merchant
nodes.notes: The parent hands over the merchant and the backend URL. Nothing here hardcodes either.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ merchant_id: $('Start the night for one merchant').first().json.merchant_id }) }}

nodes.name: Is anything wrong at this shop
nodes.notes: Pure arithmetic over the ledger. This runs for every merchant, every night, and costs nothing but CPU.

nodes.name: Is it worth a phone call
nodes.notes: Roughly ninety seven nights in a hundred go down the lower branch. That is the whole cost argument.

nodes.name: No call tonight
nodes.notes: Deciding to stay quiet is a decision. It is on the canvas because it is a feature, not a gap.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ stage: 'triage', decision: 'no_call', headline: 'no call tonight', merchant_id: $('Start the night for one merchant').first().json.merchant_id, source: 'n8n', detail: { opportunity_score: $('Is anything wrong at this shop').first().json.opportunity_score, revenue_share: $('Is anything wrong at this shop').first().json.revenue_share, thresholds: $('Is anything wrong at this shop').first().json.thresholds } }) }}

nodes.name: Write down that we stayed quiet

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ merchant_id: $('Start the night for one merchant').first().json.merchant_id }) }}

nodes.name: Ask the model what to try
nodes.notes: The model proposes the action and the audience. It is never asked for a number.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ merchant_id: $('Start the night for one merchant').first().json.merchant_id, candidates: $json.candidates }) }}

nodes.name: Price every offer depth
nodes.notes: Each candidate is priced at LOW, MEDIUM and HIGH. Whatever loses money is refused here, not on the call.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ merchant_id: $('Start the night for one merchant').first().json.merchant_id, callback_url: $execution.resumeUrl }) }}

nodes.name: Phone the shopkeeper in Hindi
nodes.notes: Hands the backend the resume URL of the Wait node below, so the call wakes this workflow the moment the merchant answers.

nodes.name: Wait for the merchant to answer
nodes.notes: Parks the run on a real event rather than polling. If nobody answers within three minutes it resumes anyway and the switch below falls through to no answer.

nodes.name: What did he say
nodes.notes: Three ways, not two. A no and a missed call are different facts and are handled by different branches.

nodes.name: Hold back fifteen percent at random
nodes.notes: The control group never gets a message. Not messaging them is the entire experiment.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ merchant_id: $json.merchant_id, call_id: $json.call_id, seed: $json.seed, treated: $json.treated, control: $json.control }) }}

nodes.name: Send the Hindi messages
nodes.notes: Retries three times. The split is a hash, not a shuffle, so a retry sends to exactly the same people and cannot double treat anybody.

nodes.name: Wait seventy two hours
nodes.notes: A three day business process with no scheduler of our own. n8n holds the execution open and picks it back up on Monday.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ merchant_id: $('Start the night for one merchant').first().json.merchant_id, campaign_id: $('Send the Hindi messages').first().json.campaign_id }) }}

nodes.name: Measure what actually happened
nodes.notes: Lift is treated conversion minus control conversion. Nothing here is estimated.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ merchant_id: $('Start the night for one merchant').first().json.merchant_id, campaign_id: $('Send the Hindi messages').first().json.campaign_id }) }}

nodes.name: Write the lesson back to memory
nodes.notes: Predicted against actual. This is the node that makes campaign six better than campaign one.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ stage: 'call', decision: 'declined', headline: 'the merchant said no, nothing was sent', merchant_id: $('Start the night for one merchant').first().json.merchant_id, source: 'n8n', detail: { call_id: $('Phone the shopkeeper in Hindi').first().json.call_id } }) }}

nodes.name: Log that he said no
nodes.notes: A no is information. It is logged on its own branch, not folded in with a missed call.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ stage: 'call', decision: 'no_answer', headline: 'nobody picked up, try again tomorrow night', merchant_id: $('Start the night for one merchant').first().json.merchant_id, source: 'n8n', detail: { call_id: $('Phone the shopkeeper in Hindi').first().json.call_id } }) }}

nodes.name: Log that nobody picked up
nodes.notes: Different from a no. This merchant gets another attempt tomorrow, a refusal does not.
